scope: Actual native Driver two-cycle one-core/eight-core controls at t=.0002 versus independently evolved N2049 spherical profiles. All scientific FAIL; no spatial-convergence or collapse-safety claim.
temporal_control_limit: Native actual Driver Ketcheson 2S RK4 versus stored radial classical RK4 at dt1e-4; independent timestep refinement remains required.
weight_definition: CSV map_volume*sqrt(det(g_tilde))/chi^(3/2), Penrose spatial proper-volume quadrature. Every active cell retained; no Omega factor, floor, clipping or radial exclusion.
region_note: All is the acceptance norm over every cell. Other regions overlap; no region replaces it. Inferred Cartesian spacing tier is a diagnostic, not a native AMR level.
angular_method: All actual nodal Cartesian components projected radially for diagnostics only. Geometrically coincident radii grouped by round(r,14), retaining raw values/directions and per-group counts. No interpolated rays, symmetrized evolution or radial-value projection.

original_vector_residual.source: actual Driver independently checked original vector equation, not potential/preconditioner residual; derivative-incomplete CSV does not permit independent regional reconstruction
